$comment: Single source of truth for the hua-mcp fleet. Ports/env/transport live HERE; servers read it via shared/fleet.py, and PM2 + agent MCP configs should be derived from it, never hand-synced. Port plan: 8001-8009 = per-environment multi-tool servers; 8010+ = heavy / single-purpose / publicly-exposed servers (own process, own blast radius). Add a tool = drop a tools/<name>.py with register(mcp); add a server = add an entry here.

servers.name: win-agents
servers.desc: Windows-only APIs + things that must run on the Windows host (clipboard, GUI, services, sing-box/Clash proxy control).

servers.name: wsl-agents
servers.desc: Linux-native tools: model identity checks, Claude Code session recovery (reff), bash/docker.

servers.name: cloud-api
servers.desc: Pure network calls (AWS/Jira/RSS) — no local env deps; hosted on WSL for now.

servers.name: md2pdf
servers.desc: Markdown -> premium PDF (offline, mermaid-capable). Own process: Chromium is heavy and can hang. Same process also serves REST /pdf for the future public website endpoint.
